payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_runtime.py::test_allocate_network_admits_the_host_before_its_walk_and_names_the_last_refusal stayed green with the spec's wrong version "The walk catches the host's refusal like any refused create and moves to the next /24." applied to saffron/cell/runtime.py as an edit. The claim was "`allocate_network` admits the host once, before its walk. On a host the selected runtime refuses, it raises that refusal after one `info` call and no `network` call. When every /24 of the pool is refused, its error carries the last refused create's own error text, and not the first one's.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
